description: Verify a carbon project's basic NDVI via Sentinel-2. Returns signed Ed25519 NDVI attestation. No Lean 4 proof. Not a carbon credit. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, ISO 14064-3 lite. Cost £5 per call.

claimed_ndvi_min.description: Minimum NDVI the agent claims the project has achieved.

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the carbon project (e.g., 'CV-SOUTHAMPTON-01').

name: request_mrv_report_lite

outputSchema.description: Basic NDVI verification with a signed Ed25519 attestation. No Lean 4 proof.

disclaimer.description: Basic NDVI only. Not a full MRV report.

ndvi_claimed_min.description: Claimed minimum NDVI echoed from the request.

ndvi_estimated.description: Estimated NDVI from Sentinel-2 / MWCM-Oh optical indices.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

verification_passed.description: True when estimated NDVI meets the claimed minimum.
